name: OpenClaw
description: Self-hosted open-source personal agent runtime with a skill marketplace.
descriptionZh: 可自托管、开源的个人智能体运行时，带技能市场。
keyFact: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted personal agent runtime with no hosted tier: state, memory and credentials stay on the user's own machine behind a local gateway. Its creator Peter Steinberger joined OpenAI in February 2026 as an acqui-hire, and the project is now governed by the independent OpenClaw Foundation.
keyFactZh: OpenClaw 是 MIT 许可、可自托管且没有托管版的自托管个人智能体运行时：状态、记忆与凭证都留在用户本机，由本地 Gateway 管理。其创建者 Peter Steinberger 于 2026 年 2 月以 acqui-hire 形式加入 OpenAI，项目现由独立的 OpenClaw Foundation 治理。
caveat: Third-party sites report star counts between roughly 346,000 and 400,000 with no agreed figure. A site calling itself OpenClaw Cloud / getopenclaw.ai presents itself as official, which contradicts the project's stated position of having no hosted tier.
caveatZh: 第三方站点给出的星标在约 34.6 万至 40 万之间，无一致口径。另有自称官方的 OpenClaw Cloud / getopenclaw.ai 站点，与项目方「不提供托管版」的公开表述相矛盾。
